Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — Novara is working through our vendor security review for a go-live next month and we need an official continuity addendum (sometimes called a bridge letter) that covers the period after your most recent SOC 2 Type II report. Our checklist asks for a signed statement covering the interval from the report end date through the current date, and an evidence inventory for any items called out.

Details we have so far:
- SOC 2 Type II report end date on our record: 2026-06-30
- Requested coverage window: 2026-07-01 through today (we can accept a rolling statement to the date you sign)
- Primary asks: confirmation of no material control changes affecting scope, list of any compensating controls or deviations, and a short list of evidence items (e.g., recent SOC auditor letter if available, KMS attestations, change-control summary).

I attached our questionnaire (Novara_Security_Questionnaire_v3.pdf) with a mapping to the controls we need to verify. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: (a) a signed continuity addendum on company letterhead, (b) a list of items you can supply as evidence, and (c) an estimated turnaround? Our target is to get a completed package to procurement by Friday, Oct 22.

If helpful, please loop in your audit or compliance lead.

Thanks,

3) Turnaround: If you can confirm the exact coverage end date you need (e.g., 2026-10-18 or a later sign date), we can send a draft addendum by EOD 2026-10-19 and a signed PDF by 2026-10-21, pending sign-off from Legal. If you need it faster we can escalate.
